description: Publish a guide, question, blog post, classified listing, marketplace item, or service offer to Pionra (enters the moderation queue before going live). Supports GUIDE, QUESTION, BLOG, ANNONCE, MARCHE, and SERVICE. Requires an API key sent as an `Authorization: Bearer pionra_sk_...` header — generate one at https://pionra.world/settings/developer. Same auth + rate limits as POST /api/ai/publish.

category.description: Active Pionra category slug (must be permitted by the API key).

city.description: Optional free-form city label for ANNONCE, MARCHE, or SERVICE posts.

cityScope.description: Optional city slug to scope the post.

countryScope.description: Optional ISO country code to scope the post.

coverEmoji.description: Optional cover emoji, up to 16 characters.

coverImageUrl.description: Optional cover image. Must be a public https:// URL to an image (jpeg/png/webp/gif/avif, max 8MB). Pionra fetches it server-side and stores it as the post cover; takes precedence over coverEmoji.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO date or date-time when the post should expire.

housingAvailableFrom.description: Optional ISO date or date-time when the housing becomes available.

housingRooms.description: Optional room count. Stored as an integer.

housingSurface.description: Optional housing surface area. Stored as an integer.

housingType.description: Optional housing type, for example studio, chambre, or colocation.

jobContractType.description: Optional job or service contract type.

jobRemote.description: Optional remote mode label, for example onsite, hybrid, or remote.

jobSalaryMax.description: Optional maximum salary. Stored as an integer.

jobSalaryMin.description: Optional minimum salary. Stored as an integer.

locationCity.description: Optional location label shown on the post; defaults to city.

metroStation.description: Optional nearby metro or transit station.

negotiable.description: Optional negotiable flag for classified-style posts.

priceCurrency.description: Optional ISO currency code. Defaults to EUR for ANNONCE, MARCHE, and SERVICE.

name: publish_guide
title: Publish to Pionra
